updateNotes: Skip intro: a button to skip a series' opening titles. Recordings can be saved to Google Drive. The app is now in 15 more European languages. Time-shift keeps room free on your device and resumes cleanly after a long pause. Guide: a playing dot under the channel number, and Record stops a channel that is already recording. Fixed a crash on boxes with little memory when the guide finished downloading while a film played, and the app no longer closes when Android's clean-up runs slow.
